propositions: Dense multi-criterion completion runs exhaust bounded request budgets without banking any criterion verdicts due to concurrent tool-batch execution defeating prompt-only serialization instructions
Pydantic AI concurrent tool execution allows the model to defer all record_criterion_verdict calls until after budget exhaustion, violating the incremental banking contract

An explicit finite-state enforcement wrapper at the completion-tool policy seam atomically claims one governed action per response and invokes fallback met=false banking on the third evidence response if the criterion remains unbanked
The completion evidence policy attaches only to privately flagged tools at build_agent_kwargs, preserving byte-identical unflagged request behavior and all public API/schema/exit-code surfaces

Held-out behavioral oracle confirms baseline zero-bank exhaustion (0/3 trials) with policy disabled, repaired bounded success (≥2/3 trials) with policy enabled, and simple three-criterion control returning PASS with 3/3 banks under both conditions
